spec_match.rationale: Probes the exact surface (::interest-button with author content) on the six source kinds the spec distinguishes, and shows that CSS.supports alone is a false signal.

interactive.rationale: Re-measure and content on/off controls rerun real layout measurements; specimens can be hovered/focused/tapped to show interest, logged live.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index card promises the six-case matrix with layout deltas; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Broken id, plain link, span, UA-default content none are all covered; a mismatch is reported as a conformance failure rather than hidden.

conformance.rationale: Backs the box-on-valid-*, no-box-* and ua-default-content-none assertions with the same measurement technique.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 153.0.8010.12 (Playwright) at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 touch, both without the flag and with --enable-blink-features=HTMLInterestForInterestButtonPseudo; console and network clean, 0px horizontal overflow on every run. No flag: selector true, deltas 0 on all cases, summary says the name is parsed but not implemented. With flag: +48px on valid link and button, 0 on cases 3-5, clicking/tapping the pseudo box fired interest and opened the hint with location.hash unchanged.

telemetry_health.rationale: Native branch asserts both valid sources render; fallback branch asserts the summary does not claim native rendering; a separate assert fails if an invalid source grows a box.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; emerald-dark/rose verdict colours on ivory.

accessibility.rationale: Native controls, live status and log regions, specimens are real links/buttons. The accessibility tree was not inspected with DevTools here (no chrome-devtools-mcp), so the 'pseudo not in AX tree' claim rests on the spec.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Both classes verified with real touch tap and mouse click on the generated box; cards stack to one column at 360px.

openQuestions.title: Confirm AX-tree absence in DevTools
openQuestions.detail: Use chrome-devtools-mcp with the flag on to confirm ::interest-button contributes no node and no name to the link.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible CSS generated content alt text decorative glyph
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use content: "x" / "" for purely decorative generated text; never carry meaning only in generated content.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Every ::interest-button rule uses content: "ⓘ" / ""; the meaning stays on the link and its hint.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Grids collapse to one column on narrow viewports, long tokens wrap, tap targets >= 44px.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Single-column grids below 720px, overflow-wrap:anywhere on code/readouts, 44px labels/buttons; measured 0px overflow at 360px.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce discrete outcomes in polite status/log regions; keep controls native and labelled.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Verdicts in role=status, events in role=log; native radios/checkboxes/buttons with visible labels and focus-visible outlines.

summary: Layout-backed support matrix that exposes Chromium's parse-but-no-box state without the flag and confirms spec-shaped behaviour with it.
